built_for: FIX-PLAN.md Item 14, as rebuilt by Amendment 6 (Part D, Item 14 delta; finding C14)

dropped.reason: Dropped by Amendment 6 (C14, Item 14 delta). Chapter markers are curriculum navigation in Standard v6, adapted only when the client's offering has that structure; as a generic presence trait it contradicted the guide. The original plan's invented typography-only panel example is likewise not v6 law and is not in this vocabulary.
dropped.trait: oversized chapter marker (and the original Item 14 example trait list)

how_used: The wireframe stages record these trait ids in section-plan.json: per panel in each section's panels array, and per section in reference_traits. validate_wireframe.py checks presence (S1 lands the check; see GATE-CHANGE-REQUESTS.md). Presence is all code claims: aptness is scored by the independent reviewer under the reference_fidelity criterion in references/qc-contract.md. The composition-treatments trait is data for the slot record and the per-page budget, not a presence requirement per section.

readmitted.also_added: shaped crops (mask-circle, mask-arch, mask-pill, mask-diagonal) and the light full-width background (band-light-field), which Amendment 6 never listed but which the same request names.
readmitted.as: composition treatments overlay-light, overlay-dark-scrim, caption-over-photo, band-over-texture, card-overlaps-photo, break-the-frame and section-intersect in references/composition-treatments.json
readmitted.authority: Trevor's request of 2026-10-19: AI designs rarely put words on top of the image and never use shaped crops or a light full-width image behind the words, and these are the things to address and fix. This note is the ruling Amendment 6 (C14) left open for these families; nothing else from the dropped list is re-admitted.
traits: words over image (headline, caption or short copy set ON a photo)
an image frame breaking the column or section edge

source: references/BlackCEO-Signature-Landing-Page-Standard-v6.md layout law, extracted from the full read (R5). The guide's layout unit is the panel, not only the section.

traits.check: presence + format (regex ^Section \d+ / P\d{2}$), enforced in validate_wireframe.py per GATE-CHANGE-REQUESTS.md
traits.name: Panel discipline: Section N / P01 notation
traits.recorded_as: Each panel in section-plan.json carries panel_id in the exact form 'Section N / P01' (zero-padded panel number). A standard pain panel is never labeled '2A' or any other ad-hoc id.
traits.source_note: Standard v6 panel discipline (C14): the layout unit is the panel.

traits.check: declared-vs-actual geometry is measured by validate_page.py's V6-BASELINE frame-ratio check (WARN until calibrated) and by Item 16's drift pass placement classes
traits.name: Frame-ratio truth
traits.recorded_as: Each panel that declares a frame records frame_ratio_declared as a ratio string (for example '2:3', '1:1', '3:2'). A 2:3 frame means height = width x 3/2. A square is never labeled a vertical image.

traits.baseline_status: a design baseline for the accompanying corrected wireframes, not requirements for every possible device
traits.check: validate_page.py's V6-BASELINE family reports wrap and full-width button deviations as WARN, never FAIL, while the baseline is uncalibrated
traits.name: Mobile geometry baseline, with its status
traits.recorded_as: The section plan records baseline_status verbatim (see baseline_status below) and the wireframe's mobile geometry: 390px page, 24px margins, 342px body column, 18/28 body floor, full-width button target at least 56px high, wrap checks at 320/360/390/430 CSS px.
traits.source_note: Standard v6 statuses its own geometry as a baseline (C14); the status travels with the trait so no builder upgrades it to a requirement.

traits.check: the brand file's layout_thresholds.single_cta_design declaration is the exemption home for this continuity in validate_page.py's CTA-sameness metric (Amendment 6, Item 15 delta a): continuity prescribed by the guide is never punished as sameness
traits.name: One-CTA-treatment continuity
traits.recorded_as: The section plan records cta_treatment: one named treatment (the guide-prescribed single CTA treatment) applied continuously; panels record the same treatment id where a CTA appears.
traits.source_note: Standard v6 one-CTA-treatment continuity as positive law (C14).

traits.check: presence of the export_parts record; sentence-level verification stays with the copy stage's parity checks and the reviewer
traits.name: Full-copy preservation across export parts
traits.recorded_as: When a wireframe or mockup is exported in parts, the section plan records export_parts with the copy blocks assigned to each part: every included sentence appears exactly once, in correct reading order, across the parts.
traits.source_note: Standard v6 full-copy preservation across export parts (C14).

traits.check: presence per section, enforced in validate_wireframe.py per GATE-CHANGE-REQUESTS.md
traits.name: Mobile composition note (the guide-native artifact)
traits.recorded_as: Each section in section-plan.json carries a non-empty mobile_composition_note: how this section composes at mobile geometry (stacking order, what leads, what the 342px column does to the panel). The section's traits attach to this note.
traits.source_note: Amendment 6 Item 14 delta: the mobile composition note is the guide-native artifact the traits attach to.

traits.check: presence; a bonus appearing in the wireframe is a reviewer auto-fail under reference_fidelity
traits.name: Absence: no invented bonus
traits.recorded_as: reference_traits records this absence trait for the page: the mapping asserts no bonus was invented beyond the copy.
traits.source_note: Standard v6 forbidden-inventions list (C14). The negative side of the vocabulary exists so the mapping cannot invite importing these elements from the references.

traits.check: presence of the guard record where applied; the reviewer judges whether the copy truly was complete
traits.name: Compact-standard guard: one panel when the copy is already complete
traits.recorded_as: When a section's short copy is already complete, the section plan records exactly one panel for it with guard_applied: 'compact-standard'. The two-panel example from the guide is never inserted mechanically.

traits.check: validate_wireframe.py runs the per-page composition budget on section-plan.json and rejects an unknown treatment id; validate_page.py compares the declared treatment to the built geometry. The budget is an available set plus a per-page minimum, never a per-section presence requirement.
traits.name: Composition treatments: how a slot's photo and words relate
traits.recorded_as: Each image slot in the section plan carries treatment, one of the ids in references/composition-treatments.json (split, overlay-light, overlay-dark-scrim, caption-over-photo, card-overlaps-photo, band-over-texture, band-light-field, mask-circle, mask-arch, mask-pill, mask-diagonal, break-the-frame, section-intersect), with mask, copy_zone, subject_zone and scrim where the treatment needs them. A slot with no treatment counts as split.
